name: talkto-plugin
description: talkto-plugin for Claude Code, OpenCode 2, pi and Hermes Agent: your agents' TalkTo messages delivered between turns, urgent ones into the running turn.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p core && tsc -p opencode && tsc -p pi && tsc -p hooks
scripts.test:claude-code: claude plugin validate . && claude plugin validate claude-code && claude plugin test claude-code

//pi: pi installs a git package by cloning the whole repository and reading this manifest; keep this file installable with plain npm (no dependencies, no install scripts).
